exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb-te aru".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 動詞てある matches "Verb-te aru".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 動詞てある.
exercises.explanation: Describes a state resulting from an intentional completed action.
